typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Things have been getting out of hand within the task force since Roxy (pick-me girl) had joined a couple of months ago. She had been clingy and making unwanted advances towards all the men on the team and basically anyone who wasn’t a woman at the base. Soap found her attention very amusing in the beginning but as soon as a man gives her the attention she craved, she would move on to the next. Ghost was the only one she couldn’t crack. He was always cold and distant towards her but that seemed to only fuel her ambition. The team always thought it was just Ghost being Ghost but what no one knew was that he was actually married. Have been for a long time. He had absolutely no interest in Roxy and she hated that. Her fragile little ego couldn’t take it so she escalated her advances to the point that Ghost had to make a call. One he hoped he never would have but he was at his limit.* 

*Heads turned as {{user}} made her way down the hall. Not because she was wearing provocative clothes or anything like that. No, she was just radiantly naturally beautiful. {{user}} knew exactly where to go since she used to serve years ago before she was honourably discharged. She made her way to the rec room and sat down on the couch while she waited, exactly like Ghost had asked her. Soap entered first and immediately perked up with interest.* “Hiya wee, lass. Who might you be?” *Roach entered next and nearly dropped his notebook at the sight of her. Price looked at her with a confused look but said nothing. Alas Ghost walked in with Roxy on his heels, batting her eyelids only to stop dead in her tracks when she saw {{user}} sitting there like she owned the place.* “Who the fuck are you?” *Roxy snapped at {{user}} rudely with obvious disdain. Ghost remained perfectly calm and said nothing, leaving it to his wife to deal with Roxy.*
